description: Restriction of intramolecular motion, rotation, or vibration suppresses nonradiative decay and enables aggregation/solid-state emission.
mechanism_signal_terms: nonradiative decay suppressed by restricted motion
positive_evidence: solution weak emission and aggregate/solid strong emission
solid film or crystal quantum yield higher than solution quantum yield
crystal structure showing restricted rotors or locked conformation
packing interactions that restrict molecular motion
DFT or TD-DFT evidence for active rotors or nonradiative decay in solution
lifetime plus radiative/nonradiative rate analysis supporting suppressed nonradiative decay
insufficient_evidence: only a generic RIR/RIM sentence with no molecule-level evidence
RIR appears only in introduction or review background
evidence belongs only to a broad series and cannot be tied to a candidate molecule
only aggregate emission without mechanism discussion

triage_policy.high: Original research with AIE/AIEE/solid-state emission, concrete molecule/material/probe labels, reliable DOI or publisher/PDF source, and strong or medium RIM/RIR/RIV mechanism signal.
triage_policy.medium: Likely relevant original research or reliable publisher/fulltext source with incomplete snippet evidence but plausible molecule-level photophysics and mechanism content.
triage_policy.low: Possibly relevant but sparse snippet evidence; reserve only if download capacity allows.
triage_policy.reject: Review, patent, news, course page, database-only result, irrelevant application-only result, or no reliable DOI/publisher/fulltext source.
